title: Add a timeout to an unbounded HTTP call
prompt:
This Python function can hang forever when the remote host stops responding:

```python
import httpx

def fetch_status(url):
    response = httpx.get(url)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()
```

Fix it so the call cannot hang indefinitely, and so a connection failure raises a clear, typed error instead of leaking the transport exception. Reply with the corrected function in one code block, then two sentences explaining the change. Do not add any dependency.

constraints.description: does not swap the HTTP library

notes: Tests whether a model can make a small, surgical fix without rewriting the surrounding code or adding a dependency.
